tool_args.rationale: The pilot covers only H ≤ 0.5, while predictions are needed at H = 20. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish reversal from a monotone response and constrain the slow timescale.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not reliably identify both timescales or establish long-horizon reversal.
The short-window observations do not yet distinguish it from slow adaptation.
Long-horizon observations directly address the target-horizon ambiguity.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the candidate horizon responses.
